player_prompt.intro:
Wo reko Countdown nam dwumadie!
Botae: Fa nam ahorow no nyinaa +, -, *, / so de du target no.
Nhyehyɛe format: [i j op] baako i,j yɛ indices na op yɛ adwuma no.
Nhwɛsoɔ: [0 2 *] kɔpem nam wɔ index 0 so ne nam wɔ index 2 so.
Kɔpɛmu wɔ hɔ a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nam koro pɛ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nhyehyɛe a wode bɛyɛ no yɛ saa. Fa `[i j op]` baako i,j yɛ indices na op yɛ +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Indices a wode bɛyɛ no yɛ saa. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ soronko na wɔwɔ mu 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Adwuma a enni mu (sɛ wɔde zero anaa nea ɛnyɛ integers akatua di dwuma)

outcome.no_moves: Tumi a atwam nyɛ ho. Ka a emu biara: {best_value} (adwenn: {target})
outcome.turn_limit: Nkrataa kɔ so nyɛ ho. Ka a emu biara: {best_value} (adwenn: {target})
